stem_book: A lift with block system is moving upward with an acceleration 2 m/s². Inside, block A lies on the smooth floor and is tied through a light spring balance and a string over a smooth pulley to block B, which hangs freely. The spring balance is light. The mass of each block is 1 kg. The reading of the spring balance is (g = 10 m/s²) (a) 1 N (b) 10 N (c) 6 N (d) zero
